entries.notes: Station-level AFIR/Mobilithek DATEX II-backed listing for Johanniterstr. 17, 79189 Bad Krozingen exposes this exact EVSE and the ad-hoc AC tariff of 0.51 EUR/kWh with 0.10 EUR/min blocking fee after 240 minutes. No start fee shown.

Same verified station-level AFIR/Mobilithek DATEX II source identifies this exact EVSE at Johanniterstr. 17. The tariff is retained only for the verified station/EVSE and is not generalized to DE*EDH.

policy: Only exact EVSE-level ad-hoc prices supported by station-level evidence are emitted. Do not extrapolate the Bad Krozingen price to other naturenergie/DE*EDH EVSEs: public sources show materially different prices at other sites and some sources expose eMSP rather than direct-pay prices.
